name: Direct Relief
mission: Direct Relief is a humanitarian organization, active in all 50 states and more than 80 countries, with a mission to improve the health and lives of people affected by poverty or emergencies. Nongovernmental, nonsectarian, and not-for-profit, Direct Relief assists people and communities without regard to politics, religion, ethnic identities, or ability to pay. Direct Relief's assistance programs - which focus on emergency preparedness and disaster response and the prevention and treatment of disease - are tailored to the particular circumstances and needs of the world's most at-risk populations. Direct Relief honors the generosity of its donors by following a firm policy of full transparency in all its operations. This tradition of transparent, direct, and targeted assistance, provided in a manner that respects and involves the people served, has been a hallmark of the organization since its founding in 1948 by refugee war immigrant William Zimdin.
theoryOfChange: By leveraging a global network of corporate donors and logistics expertise, Direct Relief provides high-quality medical resources to locally-run healthcare providers to strengthen existing health systems.

strengths_deep_dive: Direct Relief's operational model enables significant scale by combining massive corporate in-kind pharmaceutical contributions with highly cost-effective logistics. In FY2025, the charity achieved a <cite id="1">Program expense ratio of 99.4%</cite>, easily beating the 87.4% peer median. Its fundraising model requires <cite id="5"><$0.01 per $1 raised</cite>, allowing almost every dollar of cash contributions to support global supply distribution. Furthermore, its institutional strength is demonstrated by a continuous track record spanning <cite id="4">over 75 years since its founding in 1948</cite>.
rich_narrative.summary: Founded in 1948, Direct Relief is a global humanitarian aid organization that specializes in medical relief and emergency response <cite id="4">across the United States and internationally</cite>. In FY2025, the organization reported <cite id="1">Total Revenue of $2,266,763,483</cite>, delivering critical medicine and supplies to communities facing natural disasters, disease outbreaks, and chronic poverty. Direct Relief operates with remarkable fiscal parameters, directing virtually all resources to program execution, supported by <cite id="5">a 100/100 rating from Charity Navigator</cite>. The organization maintains high operational efficiency, supported by a <cite id="5">Fundraising Efficiency of <$0.01 per $1 raised</cite>. Direct Relief maintains a <cite id="4">Platinum Seal of Transparency from Candid</cite> and meets all <cite id="5">20 BBB Wise Giving Alliance Standards for Charity Accountability</cite>. While its massive scale enables expansive global reach, its financial model relies heavily on noncash in-kind product donations, which account for the vast majority of its recorded revenue. For donors seeking to support health infrastructure and emergency care, Direct Relief offers a well-established, transparent venue for sadaqah and general charitable support.
